title: sail config: .sail/project.yaml
description: A repository's config: its name, the sail versions it accepts, which adapter fills each port, model aliases, budgets, the designation label and the default workflow. Validated before anything runs.

name.description: the repository's name, unique among a machine's watchers

sail.description: the sail versions this repository accepts, as a semver range

label.description: the designation label; sail's own label when absent

defaultWorkflow.description: the workflow a run uses when none is named

run.description: the most one run may spend

adapterEntry.description: an adapter by name (built-in) or module path (the repository's own), with its options beside it
adapterEntry.$comment: The one open object in this schema: options are adapter-specific, and each adapter validates its own.
